channel.title: POECH ART Digital
channel.description: Close-up details from original abstract paintings, acrylic on aluminum, available as prints, canvas, metal and acrylic.

item.title: Scarlet Cobbles | Red Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Red abstract wall art print: pale tiles line up in diagonal rows across deep red. A close-up detail from the original POECH ART painting Radiant Echoes.

item.title: Lemon Crossfire | Blue and Yellow Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Lemon yellow streaks cross deep blue and pale arcs. A blue and yellow abstract wall art print taken from the POECH ART painting Spiral Waves.

item.title: Clockwork Orbit | Orange and Blue Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: A ring of pale teeth circles a dark center beside a blue chain. An orange and blue abstract wall art print taken from the POECH ART painting Radiant Currents.

item.title: Tiles Adrift | Red and Turquoise Abstract Wall Art Print
item.description: Red and turquoise abstract wall art print: pale tiles drift through cool blue ribbons over a fiery ground. A detail from an original POECH ART painting.
